captions.detailed: A mechanical assembly depicting a branching tree structure with three independent rotary branches. It features a central vertical spine made of dark gray rectangular beams on a flat square base plate, reinforced with diagonal support rods. Mounted on this spine are three separate cylindrical hub housings in light gray, each carrying a horizontal branch arm that rotates on its own independent axis. The branch arms are styled as rigid, machined beams in a medium-gray tone, complete with blocky end-caps and dark limit-stop brackets.
captions.instruction: Generate a realistic, highly detailed mechanical branching tree assembly in CadQuery. The model must feature a central vertical backbone on a square base, supported by diagonal bracing. It should include three independent rotary branch arms positioned at different heights and angles, with each branch mounted on its own cylindrical bearing hub housing with offset hardware and limit stops. Use a dark industrial color palette with light gray hubs and medium gray arms to emphasize its machined, fabricated appearance.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject starting with a base plate and a central vertical column built from rectangular boxes. Diagonal bracing rods are added as slender box elements. Three independent hub assemblies are created using cylindrical primitives for the bearing housings, offset along the vertical column at different heights and angular orientations. Each rotary branch arm is constructed as a compound of box shapes (representing the main arm, end-caps, and mounting brackets) and attached to its respective hub housing via revolute joints to establish independent motion envelopes.
